channel.title: Frijolito Public News Updates
channel.description: Public social news updates from Frijolito's 3-hour digest: agent startups, agent payments, files, WhatsApp/Meta, and model APIs. Short post-ready updates with source links, refreshed every 3 hours, daytime ET.

item.title: Phaze raises $8.75M seed to give AI agents remote access to powerful workstations
item.description: Phaze raised $8.75M from a16z to give AI agents remote access to powerful workstations, betting agents need real desktop-grade compute.

item.title: Explorium shuts down after raising $127M as founder's Base44 thrives
item.description: Explorium is shutting down after raising $127M, while its co-founder's Base44 app builder has passed $200M in annual recurring revenue.

item.title: October x402 report: delivery verification is now the missing layer
item.description: An October x402 report finds only 70-80% of sellers that took a payment actually returned a response — delivery, not payment, is now the gap to close.

item.title: Anthropic S-1 discloses $33.24B revenue; best agent model scores 12% on GDPx
item.description: Anthropic disclosed $33.24B in revenue for the first three quarters of 2026, while the best agent model scored just 12% on a new long-horizon benchmark.
